cards.review_notes: Confirm the year of July 26-30 with the church: the VBS page omits it, and 2026 is inferred from the stated Friday family night on July 31. Eligibility includes preschoolers aged 4 and 5 who are at least 4 and potty trained at the beginning of VBS, plus children who have completed kindergarten through eighth grade; no overall maximum age is stated. The page says online registration has ended and directs families to register in person at the Welcome Center, so it does not establish that the program itself is closed. July 19 is a prize-drawing eligibility deadline, not a stated registration closing date.
